newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Light Metal sees 1996/97 group net loss.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Light Metal sees 1996/97 group net loss.

text.p: Nippon Light Metal Co Ltd said on Monday that it expected to post a group net loss of more than one billion yen in the year to March 31, 1997.
The company will post a group net loss because of an extraordinary loss of more than 10 billion yen stemming from restructuring of its group firms, a spokesman for the aluminium producer said.
He declined to provide a specific earnings forecast but said that the company would formally announce its earnings outlook at 3 p.m. (0600 GMT).
Nippon Light Metal previously said that it would post a group net profit of two billion yen in 1996/97.
